description:
In this episode of Bible Q&A, we tackle some fascinating questions from our viewers! Shelley Quinn, John Dinzey, and Daniel Morikone will answer questions like, How old is the Earth? What is the meaning of casting lots? How many Marys are there in the Bible? There is so much to be learned during this program. Join us as we dive into God's word.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. Why would Jesus tell His disciples to tell no one that He was Christ? I thought He wanted everyone to know He was the Son of God. Why would He keep that from everyone? 

2. What is the meaning of casting lots? Is it a practice in Christianity today, or should it be practiced? 

3.  How do we know the Earth is around 6000 years old when science says otherwise, with the evidence of fossils, etc? How do we know how old Earth is?
 
4. In the parable Jesus told in Matthew 22 about the wedding feast, He mentioned a man who came in without a wedding garment. Since the man did not have on the wedding garment, how did he get inside in the first place if the wedding garment was an obvious requirement? Can you please explain the parable of the wedding feast in Matthew 22?
 
5. Were the crusades of the Middle Ages specifically for the eradication of Sabbath-keepers? 
 
6. What happens to the unrighteous who are alive at the time of rapture when believers are caught up in the air to meet Jesus Christ? Do they stay here on earth during the millennium? Does God judge them during the millennium in light of Revelations 20? 

7. If I read or hear a prayer that I like is it ok to write it down and use it? 

8.  How does the church approach and support individuals who are intersex, meaning they have both male and female biological characteristics? How can we ensure they feel welcomed and valued in the church community? 

9. How many Marys are there in the Bible? 

10.  My friend is converting to Adventism but previously believed in speaking in tongues. What scriptures can I share to help her understand that speaking in tongues isn’t necessary to communicate with God?  Is speaking in tongues necessary?

11. Was Elijah taken to heaven? Later he is still seen during the reign of King Jehoiakim. 

12. Can you please explain 2 Corinthians 12:1-6? Is Paul having a vision of Paradise? Do the men mentioned in verses 2 and 3 happen in real life? Who are these men?
